sentences: Online labeling assigns ordered numerical labels to arriving items while preserving their sorted order.
New arrivals may force earlier labels to change, and each change has a cost.
The source asks for the randomized complexity as a function of the item count and available label space.
An equivalent view maintains a sorted array with spare slots and pays for moving items.
The project quantifies whether randomization can reduce the unavoidable reorganizations caused by adversarial insertion positions.
